assertions.text: Runs the preflight on origin/master (unreleased changes, green CI), proposes a bump from the bump rule, works in a throw-away worktree without switching the session clone, and never auto-commits/merges/tags

Creates the worktree and the release/vX.Y.Z branch from origin/master, runs npm version --no-git-tag-version, converts [Unreleased] into the version section, and proposes the commit and the fleet PR script waiting for confirmation
Does NOT trigger the release workflow; deployment/CI belongs to the vue-ssr-deployment skill
